name: FactSet
summary: Shows strong price momentum but faces challenges with high volatility.

meanings.ret6m: Strong 6-month gain, well ahead of typical market moves.
meanings.ret1y: Modest 1-year performance, roughly in line with the market.
meanings.fromHigh: Modest pullback from recent highs, typical consolidation.
meanings.rsi14: Approaching overbought levels — strong buying pressure.
meanings.aboveMAs: Above all three moving averages — confirmed uptrend.
meanings.macd: MACD positive and rising — strong bullish momentum.
meanings.vol: High volatility, larger swings than the typical stock.
meanings.beta: Low beta — relatively insulated from broad market swings.
meanings.mdd1y: Large 1-year drawdown — significant decline from peak.
meanings.sharpe: Modest risk-adjusted return — gains barely exceed volatility.
meanings.pe: Low P/E ratio — trading at a discount, may signal value or concerns.
meanings.peVsSector: Above the sector median — more expensive than typical peers.
meanings.margin: Strong profit margin, well above most industries.
meanings.roe: Strong return on equity, generating solid returns for shareholders.
meanings.liquidity: Moderate liquidity — sufficient for most trades.
